svg.aria-label: Merged open source contributions: microsoft/PyRIT #3875: FIX: Match score categories by array membership in get_scores_async; storybookjs/storybook #37187: Addon Vitest: Run story files Vitest hasn't seen yet; OpenMontageInc/OpenMontage #897: fix(local_diffusion): use MPS on Apple Silicon and a reachable default model; MemPalace/mempalace #2947: fix(codex): read response_item messages from newer Codex rollouts; fyne-io/fyne #6658: Keep a link when editing its text in RichTextEntry; rollup/rollup #6631: Tree-shake namespace members accessed through a default export; tursodatabase/turso #11412: core/time: return NULL instead of panicking when time_date overflows; JanDeDobbeleer/oh-my-posh #7955: fix(git): count native ahead/behind after the walk; QwikDev/qwik #9378: fix(router): reject server$ calls that get a non-server$ response; transact-rs/sqlx #4508: fix(macros): reject `#[repr(C)]` on enums in `derive(Type)`; zerobrewhq/zerobrew #495: fix(zb_cli): keep installing the Brewfile when a post-install fails; epi052/feroxbuster #1336: fix: treat /dir -> /dir/ redirects that switch http/https as directories; AlaSQL/alasql #2958: Treat FROM DUAL as no FROM to close #2860; 0xERR0R/blocky #2344: feat(server): add pprof.enable option to turn off the /debug profiler endpoints; dagucloud/dagu #3610: Create parent directories for stdout and stderr redirect paths; nextdns/nextdns #1155: bug: send well-formed truncated UDP responses; dora-rs/dora #4055: fix(node): coerce mixed-type JSON arrays in untyped integration-testing inputs; version-fox/vfox #748: fix: refresh the env cache on legacy file, install, link and config changes; keep project versions off the global link and version; carthage-software/mago #2661: fix(analyzer): report unhandled-thrown-type throw sites in source order; openseadragon/openseadragon #3012: Downscale ImageTileSource levels from the level above; zenstackhq/zenstack #2909: fix(testtools): declare vitest as a peer dependency; dolthub/go-mysql-server #4124: Use every ORDER BY key for RANGE CURRENT ROW peer groups; testing-library/user-event #1339: fix: keep the string value of valid numbers in number inputs; supreme-gg-gg/instagram-cli #404: fix(read): keep pagination cursor in sync with the --limit window; oxigraph/oxigraph #2023: oxrdfxml: accept single-quoted <!ENTITY> values; rapi-doc/RapiDoc #1172: fix(rapidoc): keep fields when allOf wraps a single composed schema; nrwl/nx-console #3327: fix(generate-ui): quote option values that contain shell metacharacters; solidjs/solid-router #719: fix: let a navigation back to the shown route cancel a pending one; ansible-collections/community.general #13195: splunk callback: report ansible_check_mode per task
